repair_notes.method: Codex-assisted repair, not unassisted Qwen generation
changes: Replaced nonexistent FACT_SALES.FULL_DATE with the actual DATE_KEY to DIM_DATE join.
Replaced customer-per-purchase-month pseudo-cohorts with one first-purchase-date cohort and deterministic first-sale acquisition channel per customer.
Removed the invalid cohort × channel Cartesian product; output grain is cohort_date × acquisition channel.
Defined exact-day 0/7/30/90 retention; removed month truncation and cumulative comparisons that included earlier events.
Defined 90-day-mature cohort eligibility to avoid right censoring; excludes unmatched date keys, retains unmatched acquisition channels as UNKNOWN.
Defined all economics over each assigned customer's inclusive first 90 days, attributed to acquisition channel; clarified recorded TOTAL_AMOUNT and safe division without deleting legitimate zeroes.
Added exact output grain, rounding, null, tie, missing-dimension and type requirements to instruction; removed impossible dual-backend SQL portability claim.
Corrected false context/submission claims and bound actual delivery text; retained the incomplete starter profile/model and backend-discovery target.
Marked changed terminal semantics, original replay contradiction, single-backend and common-oracle/reference limitations explicitly.

actual_schema_evidence.FACT_SALES: DATE_KEY, CUSTOMER_KEY, CHANNEL_KEY, TIME_KEY, ORDER_ID, SALE_KEY, TOTAL_AMOUNT, PROFIT_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
actual_schema_evidence.dataset_quirks: 57 FACT_SALES rows have no matching DIM_DATE; 10 sales have no matching DIM_CHANNEL; FACT_SALES customer identity count differs from DIM_CUSTOMER, so eligibility is defined on dated sales.

read_only_validation.independent_python_temporal_check: All 725 group identities, cohort sizes, and exact-day 0/7/30/90 counts agree with a separate Python calculation over 5,000 eligible dated sale rows.

repair_notes.modal_validation: not run; root will invoke bounded runtime validator
limitations: Codex-assisted repair of a failed Qwen-generated proposal; not an unassisted Qwen synthesis success.
Both source witnesses start before backend discovery. Later source segments are not replayed, and the new analytical goal/ground truth was materially specified during repair.
The runtime is pinned to one backend, and the grader does not enforce the chronological act of reading DB_TYPE; an agent might infer or guess the configuration.
No learned difficulty, continuation variance, or training lift is measured.
The oracle and reference use identical SQL, so their runtime agreement is not independent semantic evidence.
